# Unicode 17 conformance fixtures

`GraphemeBreakTest.txt`, `LineBreakTest.txt`, and `BidiCharacterTest.txt` contain the complete Unicode 17.0.0 UCD test cases published by Unicode, Inc. The grapheme and line fixtures are sourced from ICU4X 2.3.0 crate test data; the bidi fixture is downloaded directly from the Unicode UCD release. Test vectors and headers are retained; trailing whitespace in comments is removed.

Sources: [Unicode 17 UCD auxiliary data](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/auxiliary/), [Unicode 17 BidiCharacterTest.txt](https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/BidiCharacterTest.txt).

The fixtures are governed by the [Unicode Terms of Use](https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html).
